english_taught_degrees.detail: Graduate guide: POSTECH's language of instruction is mainly English (English proficiency required); undergraduate guide describes POSTECH as 'The First Bilingual Campus in Korea'

support_services.evidence: providing a wide range of support services including visa and immigration, pre-arrival support, and social activies.
On-Campus Work-Study Support — Eligible students may receive financial support during academic semesters by participating in on-campus work programs.

dormitory.capacity: 22 buildings (17 male, 3 female dormitory buildings, an RC building, a community center)
dormitory.note: Freshmen must live in the Residential College; Building 16 (DICE) primarily for exchange students and international residents. Undergraduate guide gives Dormitory Fee (during semester) KRW 1,400,000 as an annual figure (as of 2026), primarily covered by the KRW 500,000/month living allowance — no per-semester figure stated
dormitory.evidence: Freshmen are required to live in the Residential College (RC) ... Building 16 is designated as the DICE (Dormitory for International Culture Exchange) building, primarily accommodating exchange students and international residents.

scholarships.name: Tuition Scholarship
scholarships.renewal: renewed each semester provided students maintain a minimum GPA of 3.0/4.3
scholarships.evidence: All admitted students are granted a full tuition waiver starting from their first semester. The waiver is renewed each semester for up to 8 regular semesters, provided that students maintain a minimum GPA of 3.0/4.3.

scholarships.name: [POSTECH Exclusive] Pathfinder Voucher
scholarships.evidence: After completing three semesters, each student will be awarded a Pathfinder Voucher worth KRW 11,000,000 (approx. USD 7,500)

scholarships.name: Arrival Scholarship
scholarships.nationality_restriction: International Admissions track only; not resided in Korea within six months before first semester
scholarships.evidence: A one-time reimbursement of up to KRW 2,500,000 is available, covering one-way economy airfare ... for students who have not resided in Korea within six months prior to the start of the first semester.

scholarships.name: Korean Proficiency Scholarship
scholarships.evidence: A one-time incentive of KRW 300,000 (approx. USD 215) will be awarded to international undergraduate students who obtain TOPIK level 4 or higher during the semester.
scholarships.name_display_ko: 한국어능력 장학 (TOPIK 4급 이상 취득 시 30만 원)

scholarships.name: Living Allowance
scholarships.dormitory_support: intended to cover dormitory fees among others
scholarships.living_allowance: KRW 500,000 per month, throughout the academic year incl. vacation
scholarships.duration: throughout the academic year (subject to university policy and review)
scholarships.renewal: subject to university policy and review
scholarships.evidence: A monthly stipend of KRW 500,000 (approx. USD 360) will be provided throughout the academic year, including vacation periods. This amount is intended to cover expenses such as meals, national health insurance, and dormitory fees.
